name: Share Sacrifice
body:
School transmutation; Level paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target injured creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell will only function on living creatures. When you touch the target and speak the appropriate prayer, the target heals half the current hit point damage it has suffered. Half of the amount of damage healed is taken as damage by you.
